name: Telling A Lie
overview: Scripture firmly condemns lying as a sin that dishonors God and harms others, commanding believers not to bear false witness or raise false reports against their neighbors (Exodus 20:16; 23:1; Deuteronomy 5:20). The Lord Himself is truthful and unchanging, incapable of deceit, setting the standard for His people to uphold integrity (Numbers 23:19). Proverbs highlights God's hatred for falsehood and contrasts the fleeting nature of lies with the enduring stability of truth (Proverbs 6:16; 12:19), calling believers to reflect God’s character through honesty in all speech.
